opennyai_summary.20_January_2023__facts:
T his third application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure has been filed on behalf of the applicant for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.229/2022 registered at Police Station Narmada Nagar, District Khandwa, for the offence punishable under Sections 323, 376 and 450 of the Indian Penal Code.
The applicant's earlier bail applications were dismissed as withdrawn vide orders dated 02.09.2022 and 06.12.2022 passed in M.Cr.C. Nos.40963 of 2022 and 44449 of 2022 respectively.
opennyai_summary.20_January_2023__arguments:
After perusal of the statement, it is clear that the prosecutrix has not supported the case of prosecution and denied the incident alleged to have been taken place with her.
Therefore, he prays that considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and the applicant's custody period, he may be enlarged Prakash vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/106508502/
1 on bail.
opennyai_summary.20_January_2023__ANALYSIS: Considering the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties, perusal of case diary and taking into account the statement of material witnesses, I am inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail.
opennyai_summary.20_January_2023__decision:
Therefore, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, this application is allowed.
It is directed that the applicant be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance on the dates given by it.
I t is further directed that the applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437(3)
of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
However, the Superintendent of Police, Khandwa and Collector Khandwa are directed that the compensation, if any, is paid to the prosecutrix under any of the schemes sponsored by the Central Government or the State Government, the same shall be recovered from the prosecutrix.
The trial Court is also directed that the amount, if any, is paid towards compensation to the prosecutrix treating her to be a victim, the said amount be recovered from her.
Let a copy of this order be forwarded to the S.P. Khandwa and Collector Khandwa for information and necessary compliance.
Certified copy as per rules.
